/**
 * @module
 * This module provides types definitions and variables for the routers.
 */

/**
 * Constant representing all HTTP methods in uppercase.
 */
export const METHOD_NAME_ALL = 'ALL' as const
/**
 * Constant representing all HTTP methods in lowercase.
 */
export const METHOD_NAME_ALL_LOWERCASE = 'all' as const
/**
 * Array of supported HTTP methods.
 */
export const METHODS = ['get', 'post', 'put', 'delete', 'options', 'patch', 'query'] as const
/**
 * Error message indicating that a route cannot be added because the matcher is already built.
 */
export const MESSAGE_MATCHER_IS_ALREADY_BUILT =
  'Can not add a route since the matcher is already built.'

/**
 * Interface representing a router.
 *
 * @template T - The type of the handler.
 */
export interface Router<T> {
  /**
   * The name of the router.
   */
  name: string

  /**
   * Adds a route to the router.
   *
   * @param method - The HTTP method (e.g., 'get', 'post').
   * @param path - The path for the route.
   * @param handler - The handler for the route.
   */
  add(method: string, path: string, handler: T): void

  /**
   * Matches a route based on the given method and path.
   *
   * @param method - The HTTP method (e.g., 'get', 'post').
   * @param path - The path to match.
   * @returns The result of the match.
   */
  match(method: string, path: string): Result<T>
}

/**
 * Type representing a map of parameter indices.
 */
export type ParamIndexMap = Record<string, number>
/**
 * Type representing a stash of parameters.
 */
export type ParamStash = string[]
/**
 * Type representing a map of parameters.
 */
export type Params = Record<string, string>
/**
 * Type representing the result of a route match.
 *
 * The result can be in one of two formats:
 * 1. An array of handlers with their corresponding parameter index maps, followed by a parameter stash.
 * 2. An array of handlers with their corresponding parameter maps.
 *
 * Example:
 *
 * [[handler, paramIndexMap][], paramArray]
 * ```typescript
 * [
 *   [
 *     [middlewareA, {}],                     // '*'
 *     [funcA,       {'id': 0}],              // '/user/:id/*'
 *     [funcB,       {'id': 0, 'action': 1}], // '/user/:id/:action'
 *   ],
 *   ['123', 'abc']
 * ]
 * ```
 *
 * [[handler, params][]]
 * ```typescript
 * [
 *   [
 *     [middlewareA, {}],                             // '*'
 *     [funcA,       {'id': '123'}],                  // '/user/:id/*'
 *     [funcB,       {'id': '123', 'action': 'abc'}], // '/user/:id/:action'
 *   ]
 * ]
 * ```
 */
export type Result<T> = [[T, ParamIndexMap][], ParamStash] | [[T, Params][]]

/**
 * Error class representing an unsupported path error.
 */
export class UnsupportedPathError extends Error {}

200	   * @returns {Hono} routed Hono instance
201	   *
202	   * @example
203	   * ```ts
204	   * const app = new Hono()
205	   * const app2 = new Hono()
206	   *
207	   * app2.get("/user", (c) => c.text("user"))
208	   * app.route("/api", app2) // GET /api/user
209	   * ```
210	   */
211	  route<
212	    SubPath extends string,
213	    SubEnv extends Env,
214	    SubSchema extends Schema,
215	    SubBasePath extends string,
216	    SubCurrentPath extends string,
217	  >(
218	    path: SubPath,
219	    app: Hono<SubEnv, SubSchema, SubBasePath, SubCurrentPath>
220	  ): Hono<E, MergeSchemaPath<SubSchema, MergePath<BasePath, SubPath>> | S, BasePath, CurrentPath> {
221	    const subApp = this.basePath(path)
222	    app.routes.map((r) => {
223	      let handler
224	      if (app.errorHandler === errorHandler) {
225	        handler = r.handler
226	      } else {
227	        handler = async (c: Context, next: Next) =>
228	          (await compose([], app.errorHandler)(c, () => r.handler(c, next))).res
229	        ;(handler as any)[COMPOSED_HANDLER] = r.handler
230	      }
231	
232	      subApp.#addRoute(r.method, r.path, handler, r.basePath)
233	    })
234	    return this
235	  }
236	
237	  /**
238	   * `.basePath()` allows base paths to be specified.
239	   *
240	   * @see {@link https://hono.dev/docs/api/routing#base-path}
241	   *
242	   * @param {string} path - base Path
243	   * @returns {Hono} changed Hono instance
244	   *
245	   * @example
246	   * ```ts
247	   * const api = new Hono().basePath('/api')
248	   * ```
249	   */
250	  basePath<SubPath extends string>(
251	    path: SubPath
252	  ): Hono<E, S, MergePath<BasePath, SubPath>, MergePath<BasePath, SubPath>> {
253	    const subApp = this.#clone()
254	    subApp._basePath = mergePath(this._basePath, path)
255	    return subApp
256	  }
257	
258	  /**
259	   * `.onError()` handles an error and returns a customized Response.
260	   *
261	   * @see {@link https://hono.dev/docs/api/hono#error-handling}
262	   *
263	   * @param {ErrorHandler} handler - request Handler for error
264	   * @returns {Hono} changed Hono instance
265	   *
266	   * @example
267	   * ```ts
268	   * app.onError((err, c) => {
269	   *   console.error(`${err}`)
270	   *   return c.text('Custom Error Message', 500)
271	   * })
272	   * ```
273	   */
274	  onError = (handler: ErrorHandler<E>): Hono<E, S, BasePath, CurrentPath> => {
275	    this.errorHandler = handler
276	    return this
277	  }
278	
279	  /**
280	   * `.notFound()` allows you to customize a Not Found Response.
281	   *
282	   * @see {@link https://hono.dev/docs/api/hono#not-found}
283	   *
284	   * @param {NotFoundHandler} handler - request handler for not-found
285	   * @returns {Hono} changed Hono instance
286	   *
287	   * @example
288	   * ```ts
289	   * app.notFound((c) => {
290	   *   return c.text('Custom 404 Message', 404)
291	   * })
292	   * ```
293	   */
294	  notFound = (handler: NotFoundHandler<E>): Hono<E, S, BasePath, CurrentPath> => {
295	    this.#notFoundHandler = handler
296	    return this
297	  }
298	
299	  /**
300	   * `.mount()` allows you to mount applications built with other frameworks into your Hono application.
301	   *
302	   * @see {@link https://hono.dev/docs/api/hono#mount}
303	   *
304	   * @param {string} path - base Path
305	   * @param {Function} applicationHandler - other Request Handler
306	   * @param {MountOptions} [options] - options of `.mount()`
307	   * @returns {Hono} mounted Hono instance
308	   *
309	   * @example
310	   * ```ts
311	   * import { Router as IttyRouter } from 'itty-router'
312	   * import { Hono } from 'hono'
313	   * // Create itty-router application
314	   * const ittyRouter = IttyRouter()
315	   * // GET /itty-router/hello
316	   * ittyRouter.get('/hello', () => new Response('Hello from itty-router'))
317	   *
318	   * const app = new Hono()
319	   * app.mount('/itty-router', ittyRouter.handle)
320	   * ```
321	   *
322	   * @example
323	   * ```ts
324	   * const app = new Hono()
325	   * // Send the request to another application without modification.
326	   * app.mount('/app', anotherApp, {
327	   *   replaceRequest: (req) => req,
328	   * })
329	   * ```
330	   */
331	  mount(
332	    path: string,
333	    applicationHandler: (request: Request, ...args: any) => Response | Promise<Response>,
334	    options?: MountOptions
335	  ): Hono<E, S, BasePath, CurrentPath> {
336	    // handle options
337	    let replaceRequest: MountReplaceRequest | undefined
338	    let optionHandler: MountOptionHandler | undefined
339	    if (options) {
340	      if (typeof options === 'function') {
341	        optionHandler = options
342	      } else {
343	        optionHandler = options.optionHandler
344	        if (options.replaceRequest === false) {
345	          replaceRequest = (request) => request
346	        } else {
347	          replaceRequest = options.replaceRequest
348	        }
349	      }
350	    }
351	
352	    // prepare handlers for request
353	    const getOptions: (c: Context) => unknown[] = optionHandler
354	      ? (c) => {
355	          const options = optionHandler!(c)
356	          return Array.isArray(options) ? options : [options]
357	        }
358	      : (c) => {
359	          let executionContext: ExecutionContext | undefined = undefined
360	          try {
361	            executionContext = c.executionCtx
362	          } catch {} // Do nothing
363	          return [c.env, executionContext]
364	        }
365	    replaceRequest ||= (() => {
366	      const mergedPath = mergePath(this._basePath, path)
367	      const pathPrefixLength = mergedPath === '/' ? 0 : mergedPath.length
368	      return (request) => {
369	        const url = new URL(request.url)
370	        url.pathname = this.getPath(request).slice(pathPrefixLength) || '/'
371	        return new Request(url, request)
372	      }
373	    })()
374	
375	    const handler: MiddlewareHandler = async (c, next) => {
376	      const res = await applicationHandler(replaceRequest(c.req.raw), ...getOptions(c))
377	
378	      if (res) {
379	        return res
380	      }
381	
382	      await next()
383	    }
384	    this.#addRoute(METHOD_NAME_ALL, mergePath(path, '*'), handler)
385	    return this
386	  }
387	
388	  #addRoute(method: string, path: string, handler: H, baseRoutePath?: string): void {
389	    path = mergePath(this._basePath, path)
390	    const r: RouterRoute = {
391	      basePath:
392	        baseRoutePath !== undefined ? mergePath(this._basePath, baseRoutePath) : this._basePath,
393	      path,
394	      method,
395	      handler,
396	    }
397	    this.router.add(method, path, [handler, r])
398	    this.routes.push(r)
399	  }
400	
401	  #handleError(err: unknown, c: Context<E>): Response | Promise<Response> {
402	    if (err instanceof Error) {
403	      return this.errorHandler(err, c)
404	    }
405	    throw err
406	  }
407	
408	  #dispatch(
409	    request: Request,
410	    executionCtx: ExecutionContext | FetchEventLike | undefined,
411	    env: E['Bindings'],
412	    method: string
413	  ): Response | Promise<Response> {
414	    // Handle HEAD method
415	    if (method === 'HEAD') {
416	      return (async () =>
417	        new Response(null, await this.#dispatch(request, executionCtx, env, 'GET')))()
418	    }
419	
420	    const path = this.getPath(request, { env })
421	    const matchResult = this.router.match(method, path)
422	
423	    const c = new Context(request, {
424	      path,
425	      matchResult,
426	      env,
427	      executionCtx,
428	      notFoundHandler: this.#notFoundHandler,
429	    })
430	
431	    // Do not `compose` if it has only one handler
432	    if (matchResult[0].length === 1) {
433	      let res: ReturnType<H>
434	      try {
435	        res = matchResult[0][0][0][0](c, async () => {
436	          c.res = await this.#notFoundHandler(c)
437	        })
438	      } catch (err) {
439	        return this.#handleError(err, c)
440	      }
441	
442	      return res instanceof Promise
443	        ? res
444	            .then(
445	              (resolved: Response | undefined) =>
446	                resolved || (c.finalized ? c.res : this.#notFoundHandler(c))
447	            )
448	            .catch((err: Error) => this.#handleError(err, c))
449	        : (res ?? this.#notFoundHandler(c))
450	    }
451	
452	    const composed = compose(matchResult[0], this.errorHandler, this.#notFoundHandler)
453	
454	    return (async () => {
455	      try {
456	        const context = await composed(c)
457	        if (!context.finalized) {
458	          throw new Error(
459	            'Context is not finalized. Did you forget to return a Response object or `await next()`?'
460	          )
461	        }
462	
463	        return context.res
464	      } catch (err) {
465	        return this.#handleError(err, c)
466	      }
467	    })()
468	  }
469	
470	  /**
471	   * `.fetch()` will be entry point of your app.
472	   *
473	   * @see {@link https://hono.dev/docs/api/hono#fetch}
474	   *
475	   * @param {Request} request - request Object of request
476	   * @param {Env} env - env Object
477	   * @param {ExecutionContext} executionCtx - context of execution
478	   * @returns {Response | Promise<Response>} response of request
479	   *
480	   */
481	  fetch: (
482	    request: Request,
483	    env?: E['Bindings'] | {},
484	    executionCtx?: ExecutionContext
485	  ) => Response | Promise<Response> = (request, ...rest) => {
486	    return this.#dispatch(request, rest[1], rest[0], request.method)
487	  }
488	
489	  /**
490	   * `.request()` is a useful method for testing.
491	   * You can pass a URL or pathname to send a GET request.
492	   * app will return a Response object.
493	   * ```ts
494	   * test('GET /hello is ok', async () => {
495	   *   const res = await app.request('/hello')
496	   *   expect(res.status).toBe(200)
497	   * })
498	   * ```
499	   * @see https://hono.dev/docs/api/hono#request

import { HonoBase } from './hono-base'
import type { HonoOptions } from './hono-base'
import { RegExpRouter } from './router/reg-exp-router'
import { SmartRouter } from './router/smart-router'
import { TrieRouter } from './router/trie-router'
import type { BlankEnv, BlankSchema, Env, Schema } from './types'

/**
 * The Hono class extends the functionality of the HonoBase class.
 * It sets up routing and allows for custom options to be passed.
 *
 * @template E - The environment type.
 * @template S - The schema type.
 * @template BasePath - The base path type.
 */
export class Hono<
  E extends Env = BlankEnv,
  S extends Schema = BlankSchema,
  BasePath extends string = '/',
> extends HonoBase<E, S, BasePath> {
  /**
   * Creates an instance of the Hono class.
   *
   * @param options - Optional configuration options for the Hono instance.
   */
  constructor(options: HonoOptions<E> = {}) {
    super(options)
    this.router =
      options.router ??
      new SmartRouter({
        routers: [new RegExpRouter(), new TrieRouter()],
      })
  }
}

4	export type HandlerData<T> = [T, ParamIndexMap][]
5	export type StaticMap<T> = Record<string, Result<T>>
6	export type Matcher<T> = [RegExp, HandlerData<T>[], StaticMap<T>]
7	export type MatcherMap<T> = Record<string, Matcher<T> | null>
8	
9	export const emptyParam: string[] = []
10	export function match<R extends Router<T>, T>(this: R, method: string, path: string): Result<T> {
11	  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
12	  const matchers: MatcherMap<T> = (this as any).buildAllMatchers()
13	
14	  const match = ((method, path) => {
15	    const matcher = (matchers[method] || matchers[METHOD_NAME_ALL]) as Matcher<T>
16	
17	    const staticMatch = matcher[2][path]
18	    if (staticMatch) {
19	      return staticMatch
20	    }
21	
22	    const match = path.match(matcher[0])
23	    if (!match) {
24	      return [[], emptyParam]
25	    }
26	
27	    const index = match.indexOf('', 1)
28	    return [matcher[1][index], match]
29	  }) as Router<T>['match']
30	
31	  this.match = match
32	  return match(method, path)
33	}

Routing is decided in two places: `HonoBase.#dispatch` (per-request entry — derives the path, calls `router.match`, then runs the matched handlers) and the pluggable `Router` implementations behind it.

**Flow:** `fetch` → `#dispatch` → `getPath` → `SmartRouter.match` (delegates to `RegExpRouter`, falling back to `TrieRouter`) → `compose` over the matched handler chain. Route registration happens in `#addRoute`, called by `on`/`use`/`get`/`route`/`mount`.

## Symbols

1. `src/hono-base.ts::#dispatch` — the actual routing decision per request
2. `src/router.ts::Router` — the `add`/`match` contract every router implements
3. `src/router/smart-router/router.ts::SmartRouter` — picks which router handles matching, then rebinds `match`
4. `src/router/reg-exp-router/matcher.ts::match` — the default matcher (static map + one big RegExp)
5. `src/hono-base.ts::#addRoute` — registers path/method/handler into the router
6. `src/router/reg-exp-router/router.ts::RegExpRouter` — primary router implementation
7. `src/router/trie-router/router.ts::TrieRouter` — fallback router
8. `src/router/trie-router/node.ts::Node` — trie `insert`/`search` doing the path walk
9. `src/compose.ts::compose` — executes the matched middleware/handler chain
10. `src/utils/url.ts::getPath` — computes the path that gets matched
11. `src/router.ts::Result` — shape of a match (handlers + params)
12. `src/hono.ts::Hono` — constructor wiring the default `SmartRouter([RegExpRouter, TrieRouter])`
13. `src/router/linear-router/router.ts::LinearRouter` — alternative router
14. `src/router/pattern-router/router.ts::PatternRouter` — alternative router
15. `src/utils/url.ts::getPathNoStrict` — path derivation when `strict: false`
